scripts.text:
INSERT INTO [Tracker].[DataDictionary]
           ([PhysicalLogicalItemFlag]
           ,[ItemName]
           ,[DatabaseType]
           ,[SchemaName]
           ,[TableName]
           ,[ColumnName]
          -- ,[ValueName]
           ,[TableColumnValueFlag]
                    ,[EnteredDate]
           ,[LastUpdatedDate]
           
           ,[ItemType]
            )
     
	 select distinct 'P'
	 ,[ItemName] = Coalesce(p.ColumnName,p.TableNAme)
 ,[DatabaseType]='Staging'
 ,p.[SchemaName]
           ,p.[TableName]
           ,p.[ColumnName]
           --,p.[ValueName]
           ,p.[TableColumnValueFlag]
           ,[EnteredDate]=getdate()
           ,[LastUpdatedDate]=getdate()
          
           ,[ItemType]='Other'
           
  FROM   .[Tracker].[PhysicalItem] p
  left join [Tracker].[DataDictionary] d
  on isnull(p.SchemaName,'na') = isnull(d.[SchemaName],'na')
  and p.TableName = d.tablename
  and isnull(p.ColumnName,'na') = isnull(nullif(d.columnname,''),'na')
  and isnull(p.TableColumnValueFlag,'na')= isnull(d.TableColumnValueFlag,'na')
  and [DatabaseType] ='Staging'
  where databaseid  in (select databaseid from shared.Databases where databasename ='YodilIDS_Staging_Product')--databaseid =39)
  and itemname is null
  and p.SchemaName not in ( 'dbo','custom')
  and p.TableName not like '%old'
  and p.schemaname not in ('control')
 -- and p.TableName like '%reason%'
order by 4

scripts.text:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[Temp].[PhysicalItem]') 
 AND TYPE IN (N'U'))
DROP TABLE [Temp].[PhysicalItem]
 
GO
 


CREATE TABLE [Temp].[PhysicalItem](
	[SchemaName] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[TableName] [nvarchar](75) NULL,
	[ColumnName] [nvarchar](75) NULL,
	[ValueName] [nvarchar](150) NULL,
	[LinkLevel] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Type] [nvarchar](25) NULL,
	[TableColumnValueFlag] [nchar](1) NULL,
	[Origin] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[SourceSystem] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[DatabaseName] [nvarchar](100) NULL,
	[DatabaseId] [int] NOT NULL,
	[IsNullable] [bit] NULL,
	--[PhysicalItemIdSource] [nvarchar](300) NULL,
	[PhysicalItemIdSource]  AS  isnull(nullif(rtrim(ltrim(cast([DatabaseId] as nvarchar(5)))),''),'U')+'||'+isnull([TableColumnValueFlag],'U')+'||'+isnull(nullif(rtrim(ltrim([SchemaName])),''),'U')+'||'+isnull(nullif(rtrim(ltrim([TableName])),''),'U')+'||'+isnull(nullif(rtrim(ltrim([ColumnName])),''),'U')+'||'+isnull(nullif(rtrim(ltrim([ValueName])),''),'U')
) ON [PRIMARY]

GO

MERGE INTO [Tracker].[PhysicalItem] T-------------[dbo].[PhysicalItem_RLTEST] T
USING
( SELECT  [SchemaName]
      ,[TableName]
      ,[ColumnName]
       
      ,[TableColumnValueFlag]
      
      ,[DatabaseId]
      ,[IsNullable]
	  ,Physicalitemidsource
  FROM [Temp].[PhysicalItem] s
 where SchemaName not in ( 'ETL','Err','Temp')
  --where databaseid=25
 
	
	) S
ON
isnull(T.[SchemaName],'NA') = isnull(S.[SchemaName],'NA')
and isnull(T.[TableName],'NA') = isnull(S.[TableName],'NA')
and isnull(T.[ColumnName],'NA') =isnull(S.[ColumnName],'NA')
and isnull(T.[TableColumnValueFlag],'NA')= isnull(S.[TableColumnValueFlag],'NA')
and T.[DatabaseId]= s.[DatabaseId]

--WHEN matched THEN
--UPDATE  SET        [PhysicalItemIdSource]	       = S.[PhysicalItemIdSource]
     
     

WHEN NOT MATCHED  THEN INSERT ([SchemaName]
      ,[TableName]
      ,[ColumnName]
       
      ,[TableColumnValueFlag]
      
      ,[DatabaseId]
      ,[IsNullable]
	  ,Physicalitemidsource

	  )
VALUES ([SchemaName]
      ,[TableName]
      ,[ColumnName]
       
      ,[TableColumnValueFlag]
      
      ,[DatabaseId]
      ,[IsNullable]
	  ,Physicalitemidsource
	  )
	  
	  
	  WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE  
	  and T.[TableColumnValueFlag] in ('T','C')
	  and ColumnName <> 'Default'

	    THEN UPDATE SET T.deleted=3
    --THEN DELETE  ;
	  
	  ;
